test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: During which event did DRDO outline its plan to develop Indian Integrated Combat Aerial Systems (IICAS)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Drone Industry Conclave 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Drone Industry Conclave 2025** was a significant event aimed at showcasing the advancements in the drone and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sector in India.
 
• During this conclave, the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** outlined its ambitious plan to develop the **Indian Integrated Combat Aerial Systems (IICAS)**.
 
• The IICAS is a project that focuses on building **next-generation combat aerial systems** to strengthen India's defense capabilities.
 
• The plan includes the development of **autonomous drones, UAVs, and AI-powered combat aerial platforms**.
 
• This initiative aligns with the **"Atmanirbhar Bharat" (Self-Reliant India)** vision, emphasizing indigenous defense production and reducing dependency on foreign technologies.
 
• The Drone Industry Conclave is known for its **collaborative platform**, involving stakeholders from the government, private sector, and military to discuss advancements and challenges in the drone ecosystem.
 
• The IICAS project is expected to provide **cutting-edge solutions** for surveillance, reconnaissance, and combat missions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bharat Drone Summit 2024**__

 __
 
• The Bharat Drone Summit focuses on the **civilian applications** of drones, such as **agriculture, logistics, and healthcare**.
 
• It emphasizes the use of drones in **non-defense sectors** and their potential to transform industries.
 
• This summit primarily highlights the role of startups and private players in **expanding the drone market** in India.
 
 
 
• **Aero India 2025**__
 __
 
• **Aero India** is a biennial air show and aviation exhibition held in **Bengaluru, India**.
 
• It primarily focuses on showcasing advancements in **aerospace and defense sectors**.
 
• The event includes **air displays, exhibitions, and defense-related announcements**, but it does not focus exclusively on drones.
 
 
 
• **Defence Tech Expo 2025**__
 
 
• The Defence Tech Expo is an event aimed at showcasing the latest **technological advancements in the defense sector**.
 
• This expo covers a **wide spectrum** of defense technologies, including radar systems, communication systems, and weaponry.
 
• It is not specifically focused on the development of **drone and aerial systems**.
